description: Get full details for a specific golf course by a returned Stymie URL or slug. Returns name, location, type, holes, architect, year built, amenities, public contact info, recorded closure status, and published tee ratings. A recorded open flag is not a live confirmation of seasonal opening or tee-time availability. Covers the US, Canada, UK, Ireland, Australia and New Zealand.

slug.description: Paste the canonical Stymie course URL or reusable slug returned by search_courses, find_nearby_courses, or build_golf_trip
